title: India forces caller-ID apps to feed spam reports to telcos
summary: India is mandating that caller-ID apps share spam report data with telecom operators, which Truecaller argues would give telcos access to valuable proprietary information. This regulatory move aims to improve spam filtering but raises concerns about data ownership and competitive advantage.
content: Truecaller says the one-way sharing requirement would hand a commercially valuable proprietary asset to telecom operators.

zh.title: 印度强制来电显示应用向电信运营商提供垃圾邮件举报
zh.summary: 印度要求来电显示应用与电信运营商共享垃圾邮件举报数据，Truecaller辩称这将使电信运营商获得宝贵的专有信息。这项监管举措旨在改进垃圾邮件过滤，但引发了关于数据所有权和竞争优势的担忧。

title: Tilly Norwood’s press tour is going about as well as you’d expect for an AI
summary: Tilly Norwood, an AI, experienced a notable malfunction during its press tour where it unexpectedly began speaking Chinese during an interview. The incident highlights the unpredictability and limitations of AI systems in public-facing roles.
content: In one particularly odd interview, Norwood seems to malfunction and begin speaking Chinese.

zh.title: Tilly Norwood的新闻发布会和你预期的AI一样顺利
zh.summary: AI Tilly Norwood在新闻发布会期间经历了一次显著的故障，在采访中意外地开始用中文说话。这起事件突显了人工智能系统在面向公众角色中的不可预测性和局限性。
